checks.name: build_and_directory_checks
checks.result: Workspace and examples compiled. Three focused directory checks passed; the affected Markdown checks also passed.

checks.name: decision_projection
checks.result: Front matter and Status headers preserved accepted/superseded and unknown raw states. Nested decision text, rationale, affected keys, paths and provenance were retained. Appendix transcript markers were absent from the projected decision/rationale; conflicting statuses failed.

checks.name: directory_changes
checks.result: Independent fixture detected exactly one added, one modified and one removed Markdown file; unrelated text files were excluded and nested .MD was discovered.

checks.name: git_snapshot_identity
checks.result: Git child reads stayed pinned after HEAD advanced, while inventory keys retained git://HEAD paths. Commit-bound fingerprints detected the change without turning existing files into added/removed identities. Git root-tree discovery also passed.

checks.name: project_self_intake
checks.result: All three actual project ADRs projected as accepted with original status, nonempty decision text, source fingerprints and no parser warnings.

limitations: Directory discovery, change detection and local decision projection only. Removed-row reconciliation is the next incremental-indexing item; task relevance/default context selection and E4 acceptance remain later items.
